unitTitle: B2 · Health and public services: express needs and limits carefully
title: Listening practice
subtitle: B2 · Unit 5: B2 · Health and public services: express needs and limits carefully

steps.title: Listen once
steps.body: In the real test you hear each recording once. Tap the speaker, listen, then choose. Do not replay. Never leave a question empty.

steps.fr: Il faut que vous confirmiez l'heure directement auprès du service. Le message d'exercice ne précise pas si les horaires ont changé.
steps.question: What should the learner confirm?
options: The time directly with the service
steps.explain: The speaker says to confirm the time with the service.

steps.fr: Je sais que le formulaire demande une date de contact. En revanche, je ne suis pas certain que le délai indiqué s'applique à chaque cas.
steps.question: What is the speaker uncertain about?
options: Whether the stated time limit applies to every case
Whether the form asks for a date
steps.explain: The speaker knows the form asks for a date but is unsure about the deadline's scope.

steps.fr: Bien que la consigne semble simple, l'agent doit vérifier les détails avant de répondre.
steps.question: Why must the agent check the details?
options: The instruction may not cover every situation
The agent has already confirmed everything
steps.explain: The contrast signals that a simple-looking instruction may need case-specific checking.
